dialogue.origin: こんにちは、宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, what would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 職場にすごく嫌な人がいて
dialogue.content: There’s someone at work who’s really unpleasant.

dialogue.origin: 無視してくるんです
dialogue.content: They ignore me.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それは、気になりますよね
dialogue.content: I can see how that would bother you.

dialogue.origin: どんな感じなのか、もう少しお聞かせください。
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a little more about what that's like?

dialogue.origin: 休憩室に引っ込んだときとか、私ともう一人が入っていくとそれまでしゃべってたのに黙ったり
dialogue.content: For example, when we go into the break room, if another colleague and I walk in, they'll just stop talking even though they were chatting a moment before.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 電話対応してたことを引き継ぐとき、わざと内容を伝えないでひきつがれたりします
dialogue.content: When they hand over a phone call they were handling, they'll intentionally not tell me what it's about.

dialogue.origin: とても気になりますよね
dialogue.content: That must be very concerning.

dialogue.origin: 他にも、気になることございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else that’s bothering you?

dialogue.origin: 私はわからずに対応しているから、お客様から「聞いていないの？」とか「さっき説明しました」とか言われてしごとがすごくやりにくいです
dialogue.content: Because I have to handle it without knowing the details, customers say things like, "Weren’t you told?" or "I already explained this," which makes my work very difficult.

dialogue.origin: それですと業務上にも影響出てきますよね
dialogue.content: That must be affecting your work performance, then.

dialogue.origin: お客様対応上もマズイですね
dialogue.content: And that can't be good for customer service, either.

dialogue.origin: でも上司とか先輩にはとても愛想がいいので、だれもこんな意地悪をしてるとは思っていません
dialogue.content: But they're so friendly and charming to our bosses and senior colleagues that no one believes they would do such mean things.

dialogue.origin: なるのほど、お辛い想いをされてたんですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see, you've been going through a very difficult time...

dialogue.origin: 他にも、ございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else?

dialogue.origin: この間もお昼をチームで食べようってなった時に、誰か一人だけ電話番を残さないとってことになって
dialogue.content: The other day, the team decided to have lunch together, and someone had to stay behind to answer the phones.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 順番から言ってほかの人だったのに「先輩にやらせられないから」と言って私に押し付けて、ランチ会に出席できないようにしてきました
dialogue.content: It was supposed to be someone else's turn, but they pushed it on me, saying, "We can't make a senior colleague do it," so that I couldn't go to the team lunch.

dialogue.origin: えっ、そんなこともあったのですね
dialogue.content: Oh, that happened as well?

dialogue.origin: とても気がかりですよね・・・
dialogue.content: That must be very worrying...

dialogue.origin: いろいろとお辛い思いをされてきたのですね・・・
dialogue.content: It sounds like you've been through a lot of painful experiences...

dialogue.origin: 他にも、お辛い事ございましたか？
dialogue.content: Have there been other difficult incidents?

dialogue.origin: もう一人の子も本当は担当ではない案件の書類作りを、提出期限ぎりぎりになって押し付けられて、じょうしには「〇〇さんが忘れてたんだと思います」と知らん顔されたんです
dialogue.content: Another colleague was also forced to do paperwork for a project that wasn't her responsibility right before the deadline. Then, this person told our boss, "I think [the other colleague] forgot about it," acting completely innocent.

dialogue.origin: それは、、辛いですね・・・
dialogue.content: That's... that's awful.

dialogue.origin: 本当はその子が頼まれていた仕事だったし、朝から言ってくれたらぎりぎりにあわてて作ることもなく、余裕をもって一時間とかかけて誤植とか脱字もきちんとチェックできたのに
dialogue.content: In reality, it was the task assigned to that person, and if she had told my colleague in the morning, she wouldn't have had to rush at the last minute and could have taken an hour to properly check for typos and omissions.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: ざっと作ってとにかく綴じてみたいに作ったので、会議の席でも誤字を指摘されたりして、彼女もかかなくてもいいはじをかかされました。
dialogue.content: Because she had to throw it together and just staple it, she was called out for typos in the meeting and was made to feel embarrassed for no good reason.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それはつらいですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been very hard for her.

dialogue.origin: お話をお聞きしてると、仕事上も相当の悪影響が出ているとお察ししますが、会社的には大丈夫でしょうか？お客様からのクレームとか・・・
dialogue.content: Listening to you, I imagine this is having a significant negative impact on work. Is that okay from the company's perspective? Are there customer complaints, for example?

dialogue.origin: もちろんあります。
dialogue.content: Of course, there are.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、これらのこと、どなたかにご相談はされましたか？
dialogue.content: That makes sense. Have you talked to anyone about all of this?

dialogue.origin: だけど、クレームにならないようにその場は当然対処してますから、カバーが出来ている状態です
dialogue.content: But we always manage the situation on the spot to prevent them from becoming formal complaints, so we're essentially covering for her.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そのような対処はされているんですね
dialogue.content: I understand—you’ve been dealing with it that way.

dialogue.origin: 先ほど申し上げたように上司や先輩には受けがいいので、「間違えたんじゃないの？」とか「忘れちゃったってことはみんなにもあるから」と相手にしてもらえません
dialogue.content: As I mentioned earlier, since they're popular with the bosses and senior staff, I'm just dismissed with things like, "Didn't you just make a mistake?" or "Everyone forgets things sometimes."

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、上司の方にはお話されたんですね。でも、取り入ってもらえない感じなのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you have spoken to your boss. But it sounds like they aren't taking you seriously.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、とてももどかしいですね‥
dialogue.content: I understand; that must feel very frustrating.

dialogue.origin: とても大切な事なので一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.content: This is a very important issue, so let's think about it together.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 相談者さまは、もうお一人の方の事まで気にされてて、とても心暖かい方と感じました。
dialogue.content: It seems to me that you're a very kind-hearted person, being concerned about your other colleague as well.

dialogue.origin: いろいろお話お聞かせいただきましたが、
dialogue.content: You've shared a lot with me,

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: 他にも、気になることございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 彼女が失敗した時のフォローとかもあって
dialogue.content: We also have to cover for her when she makes mistakes.

dialogue.origin: 遅刻したり
dialogue.content: Like being late,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 早く帰ることをしんせいしていなかったけど
dialogue.content: or when she leaves early without approval,

dialogue.origin: どうしても帰らなきゃいけないとか
dialogue.content: saying she absolutely has to go,

dialogue.origin: そういう時に同じ業務担当なのでどうしても私ともう一人がふぉろーすることになって
dialogue.content: At times like that, since we handle the same tasks, the other colleague and I inevitably have to cover for her.

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: そういう事もしなきゃいけないのに、無視、無言の態度で来るから
dialogue.content: Even though we have to do all that for her, she still gives us the silent treatment and ignores us.

dialogue.origin: 訳が分かりません
dialogue.content: I just don't understand it.

dialogue.origin: お辛いこと一杯ございますね・・・
dialogue.content: You’ve been dealing with so many painful things...

dialogue.origin: 相談者様は体調とかいかがですか？
dialogue.content: How have you been feeling physically?

dialogue.origin: 結局業務報告などで私たちの連絡不足になって
dialogue.content: In the end, in work reports and such, it looks like a lack of communication on our part.

dialogue.origin: こっちはなにもしてないのに彼女の連絡不足なだけなのに
dialogue.content: We haven't done anything wrong; it's just her lack of communication,

dialogue.origin: きちんと連絡取り合って仕事しましょう、みたいな注意をされて
dialogue.content: but we're the ones who get warned to "communicate properly and work together."

dialogue.origin: ほんとに損だと思います
dialogue.content: It feels so unfair.

dialogue.origin: 体調はいいです
dialogue.content: My health is fine.

dialogue.origin: なるのほど、、、そんな状況もあるのですね・・
dialogue.content: I see... so that's another thing that's happening...

dialogue.origin: そうですか、体調は問題なくて良かったです
dialogue.content: I’m glad to hear your health is okay.

dialogue.origin: その時も「あれ～？言ってあったはずです～」とかって上司や先輩に言うので、「聞き間違いじゃないの？言ったそうだよ」なんて
dialogue.content: At those times, she'll say to our boss or seniors, "Oh? I'm sure I told them~," so we get told things like, "Didn't you just mishear? She said she told you."

dialogue.origin: 私ともう一人が話を聞いてなかったみたいなことをいとぁれて
dialogue.content: It's made to sound like my colleague and I weren't listening.

dialogue.origin: いわれて
dialogue.content: that's what we're told.

dialogue.origin: でも、愛想がいいしプライベートで出かけたりしても上司に小さなお土産を渡したりして、受けがいいから何の問題もないみたいな扱いになってて
dialogue.content: But because she's charming and gives our boss small souvenirs when she goes out on her own time, she's well-liked and treated as if she's completely blameless.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それはもどかしいですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be so frustrating.

dialogue.origin: 私たちが逆に話を聞いてないとか、引継ぎ事項を聞いたのに忘れたんじゃないかとか
dialogue.content: It's turned around on us, as if we're the ones not listening or forgetting things we were told.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 業務が滞って、クレームにならないようにカバーしてるのはむしろ私たちなのに
dialogue.content: Even though we're the ones covering for her to prevent work from being delayed and to avoid complaints.

dialogue.origin: なるのほど、相当ご苦労されてたんですね
dialogue.content: I see, you've been through a tremendous amount of difficulty.

dialogue.origin: いろいろと問題は多いことはわかりました。
dialogue.content: I understand that there are many issues here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様ともう一人の方が、今後少しでも気持ちがラクになれるといいのですが・・・
dialogue.content: I hope you and your colleague can feel a bit more at ease going forward...

dialogue.origin: そうしたいです
dialogue.content: I want that.

dialogue.origin: 環境を少しお聞きしたのですが、職場、チームは何名体制なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I'd like to ask a bit about your work environment. How many people are on your team?

dialogue.origin: 12名で3人ずつが同じ時間に同じ業務を行う感じです
dialogue.content: There are 12 of us, and we work in groups of three on the same tasks at the same time.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ３名のうちの一人が意地悪なのですか？意地悪なのはその人一人ですか？
dialogue.content: Is it one person out of the three who's being mean? Is it just that one person?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、有難うございます。ところで、ここまでの事、何か心当たりはあったりしますか？
dialogue.content: I see, thank you. By the way, do you have any idea what might have caused this?

dialogue.origin: ないんです
dialogue.content: No, I don't.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃からとか、何かのキッカケみたいなのは感じるところございますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have a sense of when it started, or any trigger?

dialogue.origin: 4月から彼女は転勤してきたのでそれからです
dialogue.content: It's been happening since she transferred to our department in April.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、転勤してきてすぐからですか・・・
dialogue.content: I see, so it started right after she transferred...

dialogue.origin: もともと意地悪な性格なんですかね？何か社内で噂とかあったりしましたか？
dialogue.content: Do you think she just has a mean personality? Have you heard any rumors about her within the company?

dialogue.origin: 転勤者なのでわからないです
dialogue.content: I don't know, since she's a transferee.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。判りました。ところで、その意地悪な状況を知ってるのは、見ている方は、他にいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Understood. By the way, is there anyone else who has seen this mean behavior or knows about the situation?

dialogue.origin: ですので、先ほどから申しあげたとおりです
dialogue.content: So, it's just as I've been saying.

dialogue.origin: 上司や先輩などの周りにいる人には愛想がいいしお土産なんか渡して評判がいいのです
dialogue.content: She's charming to our bosses and senior colleagues, gives them souvenirs, and has a good reputation.

dialogue.origin: わかりました、隣のチームの誰か見てるとかあるかと思いまして・・・すいません。
dialogue.content: I understand. I was just wondering if perhaps someone from the next team might have seen something... my apologies.

dialogue.origin: お辛い話をいろいろお話いただき、有難うございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing all of these difficult experiences with me.

dialogue.origin: 愚痴を言えてよかったです
dialogue.content: I'm glad I could vent.

dialogue.origin: 少しお話を纏めさせて頂いて宜しいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Would it be all right if I took a moment to summarize what we've talked about?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 昨年４月以降、同じチームの一人の方が業務上支障がある言動を行っている。
dialogue.content: Since last April, one person on your team has been engaging in behavior that interferes with work.

dialogue.origin: それは相談者様ともう一人の同僚の方に対する支障も多大で、お二人非常に嫌な思い、辛い思いをされている。
dialogue.content: This has caused significant trouble for both you and another colleague, and you are both feeling very upset and distressed.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様は、もう一人の同僚の方の心情も考え、この状況を何とか変えたいとお考えで、本日ご相談頂いている。
dialogue.content: You are concerned for your colleague’s feelings as well and would like to change this situation, which is why you reached out today.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい有難うございます。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 気になる事を少しお話させて頂きます。
dialogue.content: If I may, I’d like to share a few thoughts that concern me.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様、同僚の方への良くない言動は勿論NGと思います。人としてダメかと。
dialogue.content: This negative behavior toward you and your colleague is, of course, not acceptable. I think it's wrong on a human level.

dialogue.origin: また、、
dialogue.content: Also...

dialogue.origin: ご自身と同僚の方の心身疲労を考えると、このままではいけないかと。
dialogue.content: Considering the mental and physical exhaustion for both you and your colleague, I feel this situation cannot continue as it is.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I agree.

dialogue.origin: それに、会社の業務上の支障も相当だと思います。
dialogue.content: Additionally, I believe it's causing considerable disruption to the company's operations.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 会社に不利益を与えているように察します。
dialogue.content: I sense that it's detrimental to the company.

dialogue.origin: そこで、上司の方にしっかり事実をご相談された方が、宜しいかとお察ししますが、いかがでしょうか？会社の利益に反してますよね・・・
dialogue.content: Therefore, I think it would be best to properly consult with your boss about the facts. What do you think? This goes against the company's interests, doesn't it...?

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方とお二人で。
dialogue.content: Together with your colleague.

dialogue.origin: もう相談しました
dialogue.content: I already talked to them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、でも聞き入れてもらえなかった
dialogue.content: I see, but they didn't listen.

dialogue.origin: それが先ほどからの問題にしてもらえないと言う事です
dialogue.content: That's the problem I've been describing; they won't take it seriously.

dialogue.origin: ってことでしたね。
dialogue.content: Right, that's what you said.

dialogue.origin: はい、上司の方は何名くらいですか？
dialogue.content: Okay, how many supervisors are there?

dialogue.origin: 会社の利益とかどうでもいいですはっきり言って
dialogue.content: To be honest, I don’t care about the company’s interests.

dialogue.origin: 上司は一名です
dialogue.content: There's one supervisor.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様にとってはそんな気持ちなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand that's how you feel.

dialogue.origin: 大人なんだからお互いで話し合って解決できるはずだよって言われました
dialogue.content: I was told, "You're all adults, you should be able to talk it out and resolve it yourselves."

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.content: I see, that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: 一方で、上司の方たちは、会社の利益を考えてると思いますので、そこに反する事は重要な事項かと思います。
dialogue.content: On the other hand, your superiors are likely thinking about the company's interests, so anything that goes against that should be an important matter to them.

dialogue.origin: べつに会社の利益とか私に関係ないです
dialogue.content: The company’s interests don’t matter to me.

dialogue.origin: もし、上司が複数いらっしゃるのであれば、
dialogue.content: If there were multiple supervisors, then—

dialogue.origin: 分かりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: はい、会社の利益は上司が聞き入れる手段としてお話させて頂きました。
dialogue.content: Yes, I brought up the company's interests as a way to get your boss to listen.

dialogue.origin: ずっと考えていた通り、彼女がエスカレートしたらやめるしかないですよね
dialogue.content: Just as I've been thinking, if her behavior escalates, my only choice is to quit, right?

dialogue.origin: 事は重大化と思いますので、何度も何度も、訴える、会社の上層部の方に話していく必要があると思いました。
dialogue.content: I believe this is a serious matter, so I think it's necessary to repeatedly appeal and speak to the company's upper management.

dialogue.origin: 他に解決に向かえる手段があればいいのですが、、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It would be good if there were another way to resolve this... what do you think?

dialogue.origin: この状態で退社されるのは、それはそれで苦痛ですよね・・・
dialogue.content: Leaving the company under these circumstances would be painful in its own way, wouldn't it...?

dialogue.origin: 直属の上司が取り合ってくれないことをその上の上司に飛び越えて訴えるってことですか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean I should go over my direct supervisor's head and appeal to their boss?

dialogue.origin: あまりうちの会社ではそういうことをする人はいないんですが
dialogue.content: Not many people do that in my company.

dialogue.origin: やったほうがいいんですね！
dialogue.content: But I should do it!

dialogue.origin: どうですか、ご自身と同僚の方の心労を考えると・・・必要かと感じました。
dialogue.content: What do you think? Considering the stress on you and your colleague... I feel it's necessary.

dialogue.origin: 上層部って例えばどこに言えばいいんですか？
dialogue.content: Upper management... who exactly should I talk to?

dialogue.origin: 他に対処法があれば別ですが
dialogue.content: Unless there's another way to handle it.

dialogue.origin: 必要ならやります！
dialogue.content: If it's necessary, I'll do it!

dialogue.origin: 他に対処法があるんですか？
dialogue.content: Are there other ways to handle it?

dialogue.origin: 上司の方の他、総括部門だったり、相談窓口だったり、社長さんだったり・・・
dialogue.content: Besides your supervisor, there might be a general affairs department, an internal consultation desk, or even the company president...

dialogue.origin: 会社は6万人なので
dialogue.content: It's a company of 60,000 people, so...

dialogue.origin: いえ、相談者様が思う対処法があれば、、、ってことでした。
dialogue.content: No, I just meant if you could think of another way...

dialogue.origin: 社長は無理ですが
dialogue.content: The president is impossible, but...

dialogue.origin: 大企業なのですね
dialogue.content: It's a large corporation, I see.

dialogue.origin: 上層部って
dialogue.content: Upper management...

dialogue.origin: やっぱり直属の課長の上ってことですよね
dialogue.content: So you mean the person above my direct section manager, right?

dialogue.origin: そうすると、社内相談窓口とか、社外相談窓口もあると思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: In that case, there might also be an internal or external consultation service. How about that?

dialogue.origin: 社内窓口ですね
dialogue.content: The internal service, I see.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: はい、課長の上のかたとか、隣の課長さんとかでも、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes—perhaps your section manager’s superior or a section manager from a neighboring department could also be an option. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: いえ、シャンし窓口にします
dialogue.content: No, I’ll use the in-house consultation desk.

dialogue.origin: 社内
dialogue.content: The internal one.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい、一度ご相談されてみてください。
dialogue.content: Yes, please try consulting with them.

dialogue.origin: 相談されて、今後改善される事を願っております。
dialogue.content: I hope that by talking to them, the situation will improve.

dialogue.origin: 改善されないようなら、またお話お聞かせください。改善のアドバイスはできないかもしれませんが、お話お聴きすることはできますので。
dialogue.content: If things don't get better, please feel free to talk to me again. I may not be able to advise on how to fix it, but I can always listen.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.
